main_measure.name: t-stat of mean of (forecast/10 x block forward 24-bar excess return over window mean 24-bar return)
main_measure.threshold: t-stat >= 2 confirms, <= -2 rejects, strictly between is inconclusive; fewer than 100 active blocks is inconclusive

supporting_check.name: share of active blocks with negative 24-bar excess return vs 50%

decided_by: Inconclusive: the main-measure t-stat is strictly between -2 and 2.
reading: Blocks start at positions 0, 24, 48, ... of each window with a full 24-bar forward return inside it, all blocks (including forecast 0) enter the products, the window's mean 24-bar return is the mean of the forward 24-bar returns from every bar of that window, and the supporting check passes when the negative share exceeds 50%.
